findings.message: [DQC.US.0234.10930] The filing is missing a value for the concept TaxJurisdictionOfDomicileExtensibleEnumeration.  When reporting a tax reconcilation, with a value reported for the concept IncomeTaxReconciliationIncomeTaxExpenseBenefitAtFederalStatutoryIncomeTaxRate (with a value of 45,168,000), then a value for TaxJurisdictionOfDomicileExtensibleEnumeration must also be provided to indicate the domestic tax jurisdiction. - jwa-20260430.htm 8
